answer: fable issues one enrollment certificate per verified operator; river keeps its lifetime identity tally across wallets and hosts. The \(k\)th identity enrolls only when \(3^{k-1}\) timber secure modules pass hardware attestation in one ceremony, retiring every module’s enrollment key. One identity consumes 1 module; ten require 29,524 distinct modules, the tenth alone 19,683. Parallel ceremonies cannot reuse modules or cut the total, fresh keys cannot reset the tally, and another operator’s debut still consumes 1.
